cards.title: Accessibility Phase 1 — IconButton tooltips
cards.description: Add tooltip: to all 27 IconButton instances across ~15 files. Mechanical fix — every IconButton must have a tooltip per accessibility.md rules.
cards.notes: Written 2026-06-02 but never committed until 2026-07-30 (commit 27ab24c, combined with card-009's Semantics work) — see card-011. Added tooltips to 23 IconButtons across 13 files (3 already had tooltips). Verified zero missing with Python regex scan.

cards.title: Accessibility Phase 2 — Form labels
cards.description: Add labelText: to all TextFields/TextFormFields using hintText as their only label (~20 instances across ~10 files). Convert hints to format examples only.
cards.notes: Done 2026-06-02. Added labelText to: amount + description fields in add_edit_event_dialog; monthly income fields in budget_setup_screen and budget_settings_screen; parent category + category name fields in manage_categories_screen (removed redundant external Text widget labels); search field in transactions_screen. Used Semantics wrapper (instead of labelText) for the compact inline amount field in category_allocation_screen to preserve row layout. Several files (add_edit_allocation_rule_dialog, budget_analytics_screen, budget_screen, saving_goals dialog, calendar_widget, onboarding) already had labelText — no changes needed.

cards.title: Accessibility Phase 3 — Semantics wrappers
cards.description: Add Semantics/ExcludeSemantics/MergeSemantics throughout the app. Wrap GestureDetectors (12 instances), exclude decorative icons, merge card children, mark section headings, add liveRegion to dynamic content. Fix 1 Image missing semanticLabel.
cards.notes: Written 2026-06-02 but never committed until 2026-07-30 (commit 27ab24c, combined with card-007's tooltip work) — see card-011. Wrapped 8 GestureDetectors with Semantics: 3 toggle buttons (budget_screen, surplus_allocation_screen, budget_analytics_screen) got Semantics(button:true, selected:isSelected); surplus card got Semantics(button:true, label:'...', excludeSemantics:true, onTap:...); 2 dismiss overlays (streak_celebration_widget, achievement_celebration_overlay) got Semantics(button:true, label:'Dismiss'); long-press progress bar in calendar_widget got Semantics(onLongPressHint:'Configure progress threshold'); tappable chip in cash_components got Semantics(button:true). Fixed Image.asset in goal_integration_onboarding with semanticLabel:'Cash on Hand app logo'. Skipped 3 infrastructure GestureDetectors (keyboard dismiss, pan tracking, RawGestureDetector). Skipped MergeSemantics — InkWell already merges, goal_list_item already has comprehensive Semantics, non-interactive cards don't need it. Decorative Icon() without semanticLabel is already excluded from semantic tree by Flutter. Phase 4: section headings (Semantics(header:true)).

cards.title: Cash on Hand Premium — subscription paywall
cards.description: Paywall, purchase confirmation, and manage-subscription screens for the Cash on Hand Premium auto-renewable subscription (Monthly/Annual). Started as a UI-only prototype for App Store screenshots, then upgraded to a real StoreKit/Play Billing integration via the in_app_purchase plugin so the actual subscription can be submitted for review.
cards.notes: Code complete: lib/paywall/ (SubscriptionService wraps InAppPurchase.instance — real product queries, buyNonConsumable, purchaseStream handling, completePurchase, restorePurchases, local entitlement via shared_preferences; PaywallScreen, PurchaseConfirmationScreen, ManageSubscriptionScreen all wired to real data/purchases). Verification is client-side only — no backend in this app. Cancel deep-links to platform subscription settings via url_launcher (no client-side cancel API exists). Product IDs confirmed against user's App Store Connect setup: com.cashonhand.premium.monthly, com.cashonhand.premium.annually. pubspec.yaml version already bumped to 1.1.2+16 in the same commit that added the paywall. Local testing completed 2026-07-30 on iOS 26.5 Simulator (iPhone 17 Pro): fixed two blockers along the way — (1) Runner.xcscheme had no StoreKitConfigurationFileReference, so purchases queried the real store instead of the local sandbox; (2) Runner.xcscheme's Launch Action was set to build configuration 'Profile', which Flutter's AOT step rejects for simulator targets ('release/profile builds are only supported for physical devices'), fixed to 'Debug'. Also discovered ios/Configuration.storekit only defined the monthly product — added the missing annual subscription entry. After fixes: both Monthly and Annual purchases completed successfully end-to-end (native purchase sheet → entitlement granted → persisted via shared_preferences → survives app restart). Confirmed via `flutter run`/xcodebuild that local StoreKit testing only works when Xcode itself launches the app (Product > Run) — `flutter run` uses `simctl launch`, which bypasses Xcode's launcher and never attaches the StoreKit config. Documented in docs/architecture.md's Subscription Paywall section. REMAINING before App Store submission (not done this session, no environment access to verify): confirm Xcode 'In-App Purchase' capability is enabled, confirm neither product is stuck in 'Missing Metadata' in App Store Connect, then submit with the subscription group attached.

cards.title: Board falsely marked routes fix and accessibility work as done — never committed
cards.description: While investigating an unrelated pending diff (26 modified files, uncommitted), discovered that card-004's routes-xxx.dart fix and card-007/card-009's accessibility work (IconButton tooltips, Semantics wrappers) were never actually committed to git, despite the board marking them 'done' back in May/June 2026. Confirmed via `git log -S` that the tooltip strings and the routes rewrite have zero matching commits anywhere in history. The real work has been sitting uncommitted in the working tree, mixed together with an unrelated dart-format pass, for ~2 months.
cards.notes: Resolved 2026-07-30. Split into three commits and pushed to origin/production-prep (5b181f6): 9d833f2 (routes-xxx.dart fix), 27ab24c (accessibility tooltips/Semantics — card-007 + card-009), 5b181f6 (remaining pure dart-format-only files: budget_settings_screen, budget_setup_screen, add_edit_event_dialog, manage_categories_screen, transactions_screen). Note: full hunk-level separation of formatting from accessibility wasn't achievable in every file (some tooltip/Semantics additions shared a hunk with the formatter's line-wrapping) — disclosed in the 27ab24c commit message rather than hidden. card-004/card-007/card-009 notes corrected to reflect actual commit dates.
